answers.how: Tracked the woman walking from the first black road sign (Frame 0, x ≈ 327 px) to the second black road sign (Frame 94, x ≈ 538 px). From her total horizontal displacement of 317 px over 5.68 s at 1.25 m/s, the pixel scale at her depth is 44.65 px/m. The distance between the two signs is ~208 px, corresponding to ~4.65 m.

Measured the vertical pixel extent of the woman in yellow from the bottom of her shoes (y ≈ 373 px) to the top of her head (y ≈ 299 px), giving a height of 74 px. Dividing by the scale of 44.65 px/m derived from her 1.25 m/s walking speed yields 1.66 m.

Measured the horizontal pixel length of the overhead light fixture directly above the woman's path (~46 px for the back row and ~58 px for the main beam row, averaging ~51 px) and converted using the 44.65 px/m scale derived from her walking velocity of 1.25 m/s.

Measured the horizontal spacing between consecutive floor tile grid lines along the woman's walking path (spaced regularly at ~50 px intervals, e.g. x ≈ 341, 391, 441, 491, 541 px) and divided by the 44.65 px/m scale derived from her 1.25 m/s walking speed.
